xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5363: Merge train board: per-project Train switch flips back on after turning it off, then off again (board cache not dropped on write)

plan.title: Merge train board: per-project Train switch flips back on after turning it off, then off again (board cache not dropped on write)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Turning a project's Train switch off on the merge train board shows off, flips back on, then off again. The switch falls back to the stale cached board as soon as the POST resolves (onSuccess does not wait or patch), and the refetch is served from a server board cache (5 s TTL, single-flight) that POST /api/projects/:projectKey/merge-train never drops, so it returns a read that started before the write. The project settings disclosure writes the same field but refreshes only its own query, so the two surfaces disagree until their own polls.
narratives.Proposal: Server: call invalidateMergeTrainBoardCache() right after setProjectMergeTrain in projects-merge-train.ts (drops cached and in-flight reads). Client: add useApplyProjectTrainWrite to useMergeTrainBoard.ts that cancels in-flight board and settings reads, patches override/enabled for the project in every cached board placement from the POST answer {value, effective}, sets ['project-merge-train', key], then invalidates both keys without awaiting. The board Train switch and the project settings disclosure both return this helper from onSuccess. Regression tests render MergeTrain through the board query. Docs: docs/MERGE-TRAIN.md and changelog.d/pan-5363.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Another browser tab's in-flight board read still shows the old value until that tab's next poll.
- CLI writes from another process are not pushed to the dashboard; they show after the 5 s board TTL.
- The project auto-merge-default write (stale board mode) is not changed.
- No subscription of the board cache to subscribeProjectsConfigInvalidation.
- No local 'hold the clicked value until the board agrees' state in ProjectTrainCard.
- No change to the master switch, GET /api/merge-train/config, or the POST request/response shape.
- No new HTTP route.

autoDecisions.summary: Server fix: invalidateMergeTrainBoardCache() after setProjectMergeTrain in the route, as the issue proposes.
autoDecisions.rationale: It mirrors merge-policy-write.ts:98, uses the existing includeInFlight drop, and is the narrowest change; subscribing to projects-config invalidation is broader and still misses cross-process CLI writes.

autoDecisions.summary: Client fix: patch caches from the POST answer in onSuccess (cancel, patch, invalidate), not in onMutate and not by awaiting the refetch.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue recommends patching as safer. The answer {value, effective} maps 1:1 to the board row {override, enabled}, so no rollback is needed; awaiting the refetch would disable the switch for up to ~11 s.

autoDecisions.summary: Regression tests model the real race (post-write refetch pending; a read in flight at click time resolving stale) rather than the issue's literal 'refetch after the POST returns the old override'.
autoDecisions.rationale: A board response fetched after the write is authoritative once the server drops its cache; holding a local value against it could stick forever. Recorded as PRD D7.

autoDecisions.summary: One shared helper in useMergeTrainBoard.ts used by both writers.
autoDecisions.rationale: Both writers already import that module, so there is no new import edge; two hand-rolled copies would drift.

items.title: Drop the board cache after POST /api/projects/:projectKey/merge-train writes

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-5363.md). In src/dashboard/server/routes/projects-merge-train.ts add `import { invalidateMergeTrainBoardCache } from '../services/merge-train-board.js';` and call `invalidateMergeTrainBoardCache();` on the line right after `yield* Effect.promise(() => setProjectMergeTrain(key, v));` (currently line 49), with a PAN-5363 comment. Never call it before the write or on the 400/404/auth paths. Update the header comment. Checkpoint: run `npm run lint:circular`; if it reports a new cycle, switch to the dynamic import `const { invalidateMergeTrainBoardCache } = yield* Effect.promise(() => import('../services/merge-train-board.js'));` like the existing merge-sync import. Create src/dashboard/server/routes/__tests__/projects-merge-train.test.ts modeled on merge-train-lanes.test.ts (vi.hoisted mocks; requests carry `Content-Type: application/json` plus `[INTERNAL_TOKEN_HEADER]: 'test-token'` with OVERDECK_INTERNAL_TOKEN='test-token' - rejectUnsafeDashboardMutationRequest in dashboard-auth.ts accepts the internal-token credential and skips Origin/CSRF checks, and returns 400 without the JSON content type; env reset, HttpRouter.toHttpEffect(projectsMergeTrainRouteLayer) helper). Mock merge-train-board.js (invalidateMergeTrainBoardCache), projects.js (spread original; getProjectSync, setProjectMergeTrain), merge-sync.js (spread original; isMergeTrainEnabledForProject: p => p?.merge_train !== 'disabled'). Three named tests: 'POST drops the board cache after writing the override', 'POST with null clears the override and drops the board cache', 'POST does not drop the board cache when it does not write'. Never write a test that reads source files (lint:source-introspection fails it).

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-2. In useMergeTrainBoard.ts export `ProjectTrainWrite`, `projectTrainQueryKey(projectKey)` (returns ['project-merge-train', projectKey]) and `useApplyProjectTrainWrite()` exactly as the PRD snippet: await cancelQueries for MERGE_TRAIN_BOARD_KEY and the settings key FIRST (cancelQueries defaults to revert:true and would undo an earlier patch), then setQueriesData on MERGE_TRAIN_BOARD_KEY patching only the matching project's override=write.value and enabled=write.effective, then setQueryData(settingsKey, write), then `void` invalidateQueries for both keys (do not await the refetch). Update the module header sentence about invalidation. In ProjectTrainCard.tsx type the POST as postJson<ProjectTrainWrite> and set `onSuccess: (write) => applyTrainWrite(project.projectKey, write)` (returning the promise so isPending holds through the patch); keep `invalidate` for retryAssembly and leave switchOn unchanged. Tests: new describe 'Train switch writes (PAN-5363)' in MergeTrain.test.tsx with a local fetch stub (answer /api/dashboard/session with {csrfToken:'test-csrf-token'}, POST with {value:'disabled', effective:false}, board GETs from a queue of controllable deferreds, and every other URL with an ok {} response as fixtures.tsx mockFetch does, since MergeTrain also reads /api/merge-train/merge-backend and /api/merge-queue) rendering <MergeTrain placement="project" projectKey="overdeck" />: (1) 'the switch stays off after the POST while the board refetch is pending', (2) 'a board read in flight at the click is discarded', (3) 'useApplyProjectTrainWrite patches every board placement and the settings query' (renderHook, seeded QueryClient, no observers). Extend ProjectTrainCard.test.tsx 'the Train switch posts the project override' to assert client.getQueryData(['project-merge-train','overdeck']) equals the write. Wrap cache writes and deferred resolutions in await act(async () => ...); no real setTimeout waits. Never write a test that reads source files (lint:source-introspection fails it).

In the mergeTrainMutation (lines ~337-349) add `const applyTrainWrite = useApplyProjectTrainWrite();` above it, type mutationFn as returning Promise<ProjectTrainWrite> (`return res.json() as Promise<ProjectTrainWrite>;`), and replace `onSuccess: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['project-merge-train', projectKey] })` with `onSuccess: (write) => applyTrainWrite(projectKey, write)` plus a PAN-5363 comment. Do not touch the swarm or auto-merge-default mutations. In the test file make renderDisclosure return `{ ...rtlRender(...), client }` and add 'the Merge train control refreshes the merge train board (PAN-5363)': record the count of board GETs (fetchControl.fetchMock calls whose URL starts with /api/merge-train/board) after first render settles, click 'Merge train: Disabled', then await waitFor that the count increased and client.getQueryData(['project-merge-train','overdeck']) has value 'disabled'.
